admission.justification: The channel duty is stated across six role sources and three operations, and the delivered-text guard fails when one of its clauses is removed.

applicability: Every canonical role source or multi-role operation delivered in a capsule whose handover can name a parent.
conditions: The delivered text states the recipient-or-parent question channel; when no independent work remains after sending a developer question, the Manager records the wait in its end line and status file without sending a wait message, while other parented roles send what they await and from whom with role_message.
An actual busy refusal keeps the question under 'Pending developer questions' in the report and is retried before the turn ends.
Only an unreachable parent or recipient (archived, not found, not resumable, no runtime configured, host unreachable) opens the own chat.
A relayed answer is recognized only with the three rule-5 marks and is recorded with the quoted words where the role requires a record.
A product-held answer is taken waiting work and is not sent again; the developer-only permission prompt and upward named-chat notice remain.
exclusions: Dashboard-started and other parentless roles, which keep the own-chat sentence.
Answering a harness permission prompt, which only the developer does in the waiting chat.
The dashboard waiting mark, which this packet excludes.
statement: Each delivered parentable role instructs developer questions to the instructed reporting recipient (else the parent), continues independent work without waiting, records an already-sent wait locally in the Manager's end line and status file without sending a second wait message (while other parented roles send what they await with role_message), preserves pending-report recovery for busy delivery, limits own-chat recovery to an unreachable recipient/parent, and records quoted developer answers with the receiving agent ID.
title: Parent-routed developer questions, local Manager wait and answer provenance
